title: ICAR-NRRI National Paddy Disease Surveillance & Blast Management Workshop
location: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack, Odisha & Hybrid KVK Link
organizer: ICAR - National Rice Research Institute & KVK Network
description: Comprehensive orientation on early stage identification of Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae), Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae), and Sheath Blight. Features field demonstrations of bio-fungicide formulations and certified seed treatment protocols for upcoming crop cycles.
nodalOfficer: Dr. P. K. Nayak, Principal Scientist (Plant Pathology)

title: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare - National Soil Health Mission Drive
location: District Agriculture Science Centers & Village Panchayat Bhavans Nationwide
organizer: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture (GoI)
description: On-spot field soil sample collection and rapid 12-parameter N-P-K & micronutrient testing. Participating farmers receive digital Soil Health Cards with customized dosage advisories to prevent nitrogen overuse and reduce input costs.
targetCrops: All Kharif & Rabi Crops (Wheat, Rice, Cotton, Pulses, Vegetables)

title: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF) - Bio-Inputs & On-Farm Formulations
location: National Centre for Organic and Natural Farming (NCONF), Ghaziabad & Virtual Link
organizer: National Centre for Organic and Natural Farming, Ministry of Agriculture
description: Practical hands-on training on preparation and application of indigenous on-farm bio-formulations (Jeevamrit, Beejamrit, Neemastra, and Dashparni Ark) for biological control of sucking pests and soil fungi without synthetic chemicals.

title: PM-KUSUM Component-B Solar Irrigation Pump & Feeder Solarization Workshop
location: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) Portal & State Renewable Agencies
organizer: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) & NABARD
description: Official guidance on securing up to 90% combined Central and State financial assistance for standalone solar agriculture pumps (3HP to 7.5HP) under PM-KUSUM Component-B, eliminating dependence on diesel engines and erratic rural power grids.
targetCrops: Horticulture, Sugarcane, Cash Crops, and Irrigated Cereals

title: ICAR-IIWBR Yellow Stripe Rust Surveillance & Climate-Resilient Seed Summit
location: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal, Haryana
organizer: Indian Council of Agricultural Research & CCS HAU
description: Timely surveillance summit on early detection of Yellow Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis) in Northern Plains wheat belts. Features varietal guidance for climate-resilient biofortified varieties (DBW 187 Karan Vandana, DBW 222, DBW 303).

title: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) - Rabi Kisan Mela & Certified Seed Fair
location: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Grounds, Ludhiana, Punjab
organizer: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) & Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
description: State-wide certified seed distribution and live demonstrations of zero-till drill seeding, laser land leveling, and Kisan Drones for precision spray of bio-inputs. Direct interactions with university agronomists and plant breeders.
nodalOfficer: PAU Department of Farm Machinery & Power Engineering
targetCrops: Cotton, Maize, Wheat, Mustard, and Paddy
